throughput_and_budget.basis: Four size-eight development SCMs; 1.4 multiplier covers larger cases and variation. Separate application and targeted repair allowances. Ceiling is a safety bound, not a target. Four hours reserved for analysis and delivery. No test outputs inspected.

round1_failures: One multiple-missing model used forbidden internal backgrounds after repairs.
All three generated explanations failed structured numeric-field validation; reviewer IDs were valid.
corrections: Explicitly require assumed missing rules directly in expr, forbid internal noise and equation-only assumptions.
Expose all eligible numeric keys, suppress internal segment allocation weights in prose records, distinguish zero influence from absent support.

construction_context.selection: First canonical retained v1 LLM proposal; no v2 outcomes or allocations used.
construction_context.scope: Variables and dependencies initialize from an earlier LLM-generated proposal. Operational states/references are regenerated against the new transcript context, all nonroot mechanisms are newly proposed, and dependency retractions remain possible. This is conditional refinement, not successful fresh variable/dependency discovery.
construction_context.evidence_policy: The prior is an unverified proposal, never retrieved evidence. No old equation, source score, or mechanism description enters generation.

application.source_validity: Conditional on automated contextual review; independent researcher adjudication pending.

interpretation: This gate checks the controlled information configurations using the declared oracle family, rejection/retention of invalid synthesis, numerical reproduction of accepted models and actual sentence review. Failed LLM synthesis is an experimental failure in the primary denominator, not a passing end-to-end example. It does not certify source entailment.
